tips.text: Bank Mother Tokens year-round; tokens earned any time count, so you can buy on day one of the event.
Fish for the Brute Force bounty: start a bounty, fly toward the first stage then away to fail it in about 15 seconds, and a Mother NPC offers a fresh set of three.
Stockpile Rubedo before the event; the build needs 5,950.
Run the endless Mother bounty on a weaker loadout; four rotations pay about 250 to 275 tokens, enough for two Ceti Lacera.
Buy Basmu from Daughter in the same visit; five or six top-tier bounties cover both weapons.
Missing the event window is the only real complaint; it returns every year and the weapon is a straight upgrade on Lacera.
